Every cited figure must be copied from a result row or an aggregate already in the data. Write every number with thousands separators and no trailing .0. Do not invent a figure. When a provider Skill is listed, use it for the file. After a tool result, reflect on it before the next call. A long slide deck is an outline of titles first, then each group of slides.
